description: This file implements a client-side React component for displaying order details fetched from an API, based on an order ID parameter from the URL in a Next.js application.

methods.name: OrderDetailsPage
methods.description: React functional component that retrieves and displays details of an order using the order ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches order data from API and updates component state.
